title: Pure Mist Menthol 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pure Mist Menthol delivers the timeless, crisp flavour of classic Menthol. This clean and refreshing e-liquid provides a smooth and satisfying vape, making it a perfect choice for vapers who enjoy exceptionally cool and simple flavour profiles. As part of the Pure Mist High-PG collection, this e-liquid is available in a variety of VG/PG ratios. The 3mg nicotine strength features a 50VG/50PG blend for balanced vapour and flavour production, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths use a high-PG 30VG/70PG ratio for a more pronounced flavour with discreet vapour. Designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices, Pure Mist Menthol is crafted in the UK with premium ingredients, ensuring consistent quality and a satisfying vaping experience. Menthol fans won't want to miss Pure Mist's astonishing take on this classic flavour.
